headline: Genesys International launches Rights Issue of ₹139.30 cr
sum: Genesys International Corporation Limited's board approved a Rights Issue of equity shares valued at up to ₹13,930 Lakhs (₹139.30 cr) with a face value of ₹5 per share. The issue is being made to eligible shareholders as on a record date to be determined, pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations, Regulation 30.
detail: The Board of Directors met on 26 June 2026 to approve the issuance of equity shares of face value ₹5 each for an aggregate amount not exceeding ₹13,930 Lakhs. The announcement was made pursuant to SEBI LODR Regulation 30, which mandates material event disclosure within 30 minutes of board decision. The company had prior intimated the market on 23 June 2026 of the intended board meeting.
